finding: The scoping review supplement cites Foshati for constipation in multiple sclerosis. Complete review body remains open. No new Parkinson culinary ginger outcome at available depth.
The combined extract studies ten participants with Parkinson disease or multiple system atrophy. Published significance is pooled and the Parkinson means are descriptive. No separate ginger arm.

One Parkinson patient with impaction and malignant syndrome improved following intravenous levodopa and oral Dai-kenchu-to. No isolated ginger or separate quantitative constipation change in the accessible abstract.
Forty older adults. Topical mixed oils with massage favored lower constipation severity in weeks two and four. No oral ginger arm, sham massage or exact arm means.
Both arms contained ginger, mint and licorice. The senna contrast cannot identify a separate ginger effect.
Ginger supplied the partition in moxibustion with concurrent drugs for diarrhea-predominant IBS. The exposure is external and the reported bowel outcome is diarrhea symptom frequency.
Fresh ginger juice was mixed with a multi-herb skin plaster for diarrhea-predominant IBS. The comparison does not test ingested ginger or constipation severity.
